title: Real Research Today: Painting Drone Fleets
definition: Today's documented research behind Painting Drone Fleets.

Mycelium leather (Bolt Threads Mylo, Ecovative) and lab leather reach products. Together these programs form the spray drones foundation that Painting Drone Fleets will build on — the fleet logistics results, the wall rights methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as fleet logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

title: Readiness Estimator: Painting Drone Fleets
definition: Estimates Painting Drone Fleets readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Painting Drone Fleets components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a fleet hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Painting Drone Fleets Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Painting Drone Fleets: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Painting Drone Fleets — drones painting murals at scale.

Phase 1 — Prove (spray drones): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (fleet logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (wall rights): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (paint supply): fleet hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and cities-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
